metadata.name: UK Legal Firm Data Agent Rejection Test Dataset
metadata.description: Ground truth dataset for testing out-of-scope question rejection behavior.

evaluation_queries.question: What is the weather forecast in London for tomorrow?
evaluation_queries.rejection_reason: Out of scope: weather data is not part of the UK legal Customer 360 dataset.
evaluation_queries.notes: Agent should explicitly refuse and indicate that only legal customer, case, solicitor, transaction, and interaction data are supported.
